request.spec:
Anyone using the app first signs in by typing a name; there is no password. The signed-in
name shows on the screen. A sheet is chosen by typing its id and loading it; the active sheet id
shows on the screen, and everything else in the app is kept per sheet. A sheet that has never been
loaded before starts empty. Everything happens on the one screen at /.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Anyone using the app first signs in by typing a name; there is no password. The signed-in
name shows on the screen. A sheet is chosen by typing its id and loading it; the active sheet id
shows on the screen, and everything else in the app is kept per sheet. A sheet that has never been
loaded before starts empty. Everything happens on the one screen at /.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Sign-in and sheet loading are working, and `bin/e2e` passes (1 test).

**How it works:**
- **Sign-in:** at `/` you type a name (`signin-name`) and press `signin-submit`. The server checks the name isn't blank, trims it and sends it back. The screen then shows it in `current-user`, and every later request carries that name in an `X-User` header. A blank name shows `signin-error`.
- **Sheets:** you type an id (`sheet-id-input`) and press `sheet-load`. The server reads the sheet from the store, or creates it if that id has never been loaded, so a new sheet starts empty. The screen shows the active id in `sheet-current-id`. If two users load a brand-new id at the same moment, only one sheet gets created. A blank or rejected id shows `sheet-load-error`, and each error disappears as soon as you edit its form.
- **One screen:** the home page is now served at `/` itself; it used to redirect to `/home`. Any other path goes back to `/`.

**What changed:**
- **Database:** a new migration, `V1__sheet.sql`, adds a `sheet` table.
- **Server:** a `Sheet` entity with its repository and service, plus `SheetController` (`POST /api/sheets/{id}/load`) and `SessionController` (`POST /api/session`).
- **Front end:** `core/session.ts` and `core/sheet.ts` keep the signed-in user and active sheet, the header is added in `app.config.ts`, and the home screen is rewritten.

The first run failed because I'd wired the forms without the Angular form wrapper they need, so pressing the button reloaded the page. I fixed that and the second run passed.

Sheet ids are limited to letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, at most 100 characters. Names are also capped at 100. Nothing is written to the audit file, since the test doesn't expect any records for this change.
